value.title: Destroy unsellable low food
value.description: Spine step 6, food parallel to drink (Alan 2026-07-05: food and drink parallel).

value.title: Launder stolen lockpicks
value.description: Launders stolen lockpicks so they can be banked or used instead of fence-sold.

value.title: Skill scrolls to Trophies
value.description: Gap A2: fuzzy reserve parked with the other trophies (Alan 2026-07-03). First-class category since #14629.

value.title: Sell known recipes
value.description: Disposal spine step 5: known-by-all recipes to merchant; valuable ones list first via fc1c9638. Closes gap A1.
Destroys known containers (reward already owned) with guild-store value < 5000g. Raised from 1000 to match the uniform 5000g line.

value.title: Full container stacks → Walton Mountain
value.description: Full 200-stacks route to the Walton Mountain guild bank; the lower-priority Erin rule keeps the partial remainder (first-match-wins).

value.title: Sell low-value furnishings
value.description: Vendor-sells furnishings with guild-store value < 5000g (excluding legendary). Raised from 1000 to match the uniform 5000g line; furnishings >= 5000g still route to furniture-vault via furnishings-house-storage.

value.title: Sell known motif chapters
value.description: Disposal spine step 5. Closes gap A4.

value.title: Sell learned style pages
value.description: Disposal spine step 5: learned + sellable + sub-list-line. Closes gap A3.

value.title: Crown tri-pots stay banked
value.description: Gap B1: bank is the deliberate stock home (2-3 chars at a time, manual pulls). Replaces the lock. Must run before f0ce7528.

value.title: Sell known scripts
value.description: Dispose of scribing scripts once every character knows them

value.title: Sell Psijic Ambrosia recipe fragments
value.description: Sells Psijic Ambrosia recipe fragments (Fragment I–IV) regardless of quality. Item: 64702–64705.

value.title: Bank Alliance War items
value.description: Deposits Alliance War items (siege equipment, forward camps, repair kits, etc.) in the bank for safekeeping.

value.title: Store quality potions
value.description: Moves blue (Superior) and higher non-stolen potions to the Potions and Poisons housing storage container, keeping bulky quality potions out of the backpack. Sits above the crafted-consumables protection so crafted quality potions are relocated rather than left loose.

value.title: Store quality food
value.description: Moves blue (Superior) and higher non-stolen food to the Food and Drink housing storage container, keeping bulky quality food out of the backpack. Sits above the crafted-consumables protection so crafted quality food is relocated rather than left loose.

value.title: Protect epic+ companion gear
value.description: Prevents epic (purple) quality or higher companion equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Place above sell and deconstruct rules to safeguard your best companion gear.

value.title: Sell low-quality companion gear
value.description: Sells companion equipment of superior (blue) quality or lower. Higher-quality companion gear is preserved.

value.title: Open containers
value.description: Opens containers automatically. The Can Open filter skips containers on game cooldown or when transmute crystal storage is full. The Can Give Max Rewards filter skips containers during the 20-hour reward cooldown.

value.title: Bank stackable containers
value.description: Deposits stackable containers (reward coffers, event boxes, etc.) in the bank. Open them later in bulk or save for events.

value.title: Protect crafted consumables
value.description: Prevents crafted food, drink, potions, poisons, and glyphs from being affected by lower-priority rules. Crafted consumables take ingredients and time to make — this keeps them safe from accidental sell or destroy rules.

value.title: Protect crafted gear
value.description: Prevents crafted equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Useful for keeping gear you've invested materials into.

value.title: Stow crafting materials
value.description: Moves crafting materials to the craft bag when visiting the bank. Requires ESO Plus or a craft bag entitlement. If you do not have ESO Plus, toggle off craft bag access in the ESO Plus panel above — the destination will be redirected to the bank automatically.

value.title: Launder crafting materials
value.description: Launders stolen crafting materials so they can be deposited or used.

value.title: Protect locked items
value.description: Does nothing to any item the player has locked in-game (ESO item lock), across all categories. Locked is an explicit user signal to protect an item from sell / deconstruct / move; this rule honors it by claiming locked items first so no lower-priority rule can act on them. Positioned at the top of the user rules. NOTE: the 7 automation-controlled stock rules (food, drink, potions, soul-gems, repair-kits, lockpicks, scrolls) are prepended ABOVE all user rules at export, so a locked item in one of those categories can still be stocked/moved by a controlled rule before reaching this guard — protecting those would require a controlled-rule change.

value.title: Store quality drink
value.description: Moves blue (Superior) and higher non-stolen drink to the Food and Drink housing storage container, keeping bulky quality drink out of the backpack. Sits above the crafted-consumables protection so crafted quality drink is relocated rather than left loose.

value.title: Destroy unsellable low drinks
value.description: Spine step 6: below-superior drink with no merchant value (event drinks) cannot fall to the sell rules - destroy. Companion to the raised drink sell floor (A5).

value.title: Destroy learned style pages below the 5000g list line
value.description: Destroys style pages already learned (canUnlock=cannot-unlock) with guild-store value < 5000g and no merchant sell value (merchantValue 0). Pairs with the >=5000g list rule to close the 1000-5000g gap: learned + below-list-threshold + unsellable -> destroy. Destroy is default-confirmed via the safety dialog.

value.title: List learned valuable style pages on guild store
value.description: Lists style pages you cannot unlock (already known / wrong class) with guild-store value >= 5000g. Raised from 1000 to match the uniform 5000g list line.

value.title: Sell basic drinks
value.description: Sells normal (white) quality non-crafted drinks. Crafted and higher-quality drinks are kept.

value.title: Deconstruct leftover equipment
value.description: Deconstructs non-crafted equipment that wasn't caught by higher-priority rules. Place below equip, research, and inspire rules to only deconstruct what's left over.

value.title: Store quality poisons
value.description: Moves blue (Superior) and higher non-stolen poisons to the Potions and Poisons housing storage container, keeping bulky quality poisons out of the backpack. Sits above the crafted-consumables protection so crafted quality poisons are relocated rather than left loose.

value.title: List known valuable recipes on guild store
value.description: Lists recipes you've already learned (known) with guild-store value >= 5000g. Raised from 1000 to match the uniform 5000g list line; known recipes under 5000g now route to the generic vendor-sell rule.

value.title: Sell basic food
value.description: Sells normal (white) quality non-crafted food. Crafted and higher-quality food is kept.

value.title: Store furniture in housing
value.description: Moves furnishings to the furniture vault (house storage) when visiting the bank. Keeps your backpack clear of bulky furniture items.

value.title: Deconstruct glyphs
value.description: Deconstructs non-crafted glyphs for enchanting materials. Yields runes that can be reused in crafting.

value.title: Stock gold
value.description: Keeps up to 1,000,000 gold on each character. Excess is deposited into the bank when visiting.

value.title: Bank holiday writs
value.description: Stashes holiday event writs in the bank. Complete them during events for bonus rewards.

value.title: Deconstruct for inspiration
value.description: Routes equipment for deconstruction to the highest-priority character who hasn't fully leveled the corresponding crafting skill. If the current character benefits, the item is deconstructed locally; otherwise it's routed via the bank.

value.title: Launder stolen inspiration
value.description: Launders stolen equipment that would give useful crafting inspiration, so it can be deconstructed. Place before other inspiration rules.

value.title: Sell junk
value.description: Sells items in the junk category at a merchant.

value.title: Protect legendary gear
value.description: Prevents legendary (gold) quality equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Place above sell and deconstruct rules to safeguard your best gear.

value.title: Vendor-sell sub-5000g non-legendary items
value.description: Sells any sellable item with guild-store value (marketValue) < 5000g to a vendor, excluding legendary (quality 5) items. Value-axis sibling of valuable-nothing (list >= 5000).

value.title: Bank master writs
value.description: Stashes master writs in the bank. Master writs reward writ vouchers for high-end crafting station furnishings.

value.title: Protect museum pieces
value.description: Prevents museum pieces from being affected by lower-priority rules. These are turn-in items for collections or achievements.

value.title: Sell ornate gear
value.description: Sells equipment with the Ornate trait. Ornate items sell for more gold at merchants and have no crafting use.

value.title: Bank other currencies
value.description: Deposits alliance points, tel var stones, and writ vouchers into the bank when visiting.

value.title: Sell basic poisons
value.description: Sells normal (white) quality non-crafted poisons. Crafted and higher-quality poisons are kept.

value.title: Sell basic potions
value.description: Sells normal (white) quality non-crafted potions. Crafted and higher-quality potions are kept.

value.title: Protect quest items
value.description: Prevents quest-related items from being affected by lower-priority rules. Keep them safe until the associated quest is completed.

value.title: Protect reconstructed gear
value.description: Prevents reconstructed equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Reconstructed gear costs transmute crystals and set collection knowledge.

value.title: Research traits
value.description: Routes equipment with researchable traits to the character that needs them most. Characters are checked in priority order using TemperCharacters saved variable data for cross-character trait knowledge. The current character is checked first via the ESO API; others are checked via saved data.

value.title: Launder stolen researchables
value.description: Launders stolen equipment with a researchable trait so it can be submitted at a crafting station. Place before other research rules.

value.title: Bank empty soul gems
value.description: Deposits empty (white quality) soul gems in the bank. Filled and crown soul gems are kept.

value.title: Launder stolen task items
value.description: Launders stolen task-type items (writs, maps, etc.) so they can be completed or banked.

value.title: Stock tools
value.description: Deposits tools (lockpicks, repair kits, etc.) in the bank for safekeeping.

value.title: Protect transmuted gear
value.description: Prevents transmuted equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Transmuted gear represents a transmute crystal investment.

value.title: Sell trash
value.description: Sells items categorized as trash. These have no crafting or collectible value.

value.title: Bank treasure maps
value.description: Stashes treasure maps in the bank for later use. Treasure maps lead to chests with set gear.

value.title: Bank epic+ treasures
value.description: Banks epic quality or higher treasures for safekeeping or later sale.

value.title: Launder epic+ treasures
value.description: Launders stolen treasures of epic quality or higher. These are worth keeping — sell them legitimately or bank for later.

value.title: Sell common treasures
value.description: Sells treasures up to superior (blue) quality at a merchant. Higher-quality treasures are preserved for banking or guild store listing.

value.title: Fence stolen treasures
value.description: Sells stolen treasures at a fence. Stolen treasures can't be sold to normal merchants.

value.title: Bank trophies
value.description: Deposits miscellaneous trophies (keys, key fragments, toys, dungeon buff ingredients, material upgraders) in the bank for safekeeping.

value.title: Use unlockables
value.description: Uses items that teach something new — motifs, recipes, style pages, furnishing plans, etc. If the current character can learn the item, it's used immediately. For recipes (character-specific knowledge), the addon checks the current character only (ESO API limitation).

value.title: Launder stolen unlockables
value.description: Launders stolen items that can teach something (motifs, recipes, etc.) so they can be used. Place before other unlock rules.

value.title: List items worth >=5000g at guild store
value.description: Lists any item with guild-store value (marketValue) >= 5000g that can be listed at a guild trader. Single guild-value gate (no vendor-value constraint). Pairs with low-quality-sell: >=5000 list, <5000 vendor-sell.

value.title: Destroy worthless items
value.description: Destroys normal (white) quality items whose guild store value is at or below zero, which an unknown guild store value satisfies. Merchant value is not consulted. Place at the very bottom — only items not caught by any higher-priority rule are destroyed.
